messages.name: lookup_refund_policy
messages.content: {"ok": true, "sections": [{"citation": "refund-policy/v1/amount", "title": "Refund amount", "text": "The refund for a unit is what was paid for that unit: its price minus its share of any discount. The shares are fixed once, when the order is recorded, and never recalculated: when a paid total is split among identical units, each unit gets the total divided by the number of units, rounded down to the smallest unit of the currency, and what is left over is added one smallest unit at a time to the last units, so no unit is refunded more than its price. Shipping charges are not part of the amount."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v1/remaining", "title": "Each unit is refunded once", "text": "Each unit is refunded at most once, in full. A unit that was already refunded cannot be refunded again. A request for more units than are left is not paid; the assistant can offer the units that remain."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v1/shipping", "title": "Shipping charges", "text": "Shipping charges are never refunded automatically. If the customer asks for shipping to be refunded, a staff member takes the case."}], "note": "Cite a section by its citation ID, exactly as given."}
